name: SameCycle.exists_pow_eq'
statement: SameCycle f x y → ∃ i < orderOf f, (f ^ i) x = y

name: isCycle_swap_mul_aux₁
statement: Type*} [DecidableEq α] : ∀ (n : ℕ) {b x : α} {f : Perm α} (_ : (swap x (f x) * f) b ≠ b) (_ : (f ^ n) (f x) = b), ∃ i : ℤ, ((swap x (f x) * f) ^ i) (f x) = b

have_tree.name: hb'
have_tree.type: (swap x (f x) * f) (f.symm b) ≠ f.symm b

name: IsCycle.support_congr
statement: IsCycle f) (hg : IsCycle g) (h : f.support ⊆ g.support) (h' : ∀ x ∈ f.support, f x = g x) : f = g

name: IsCycle.eq_on_support_inter_nonempty_congr
statement: IsCycle f) (hg : IsCycle g) (h : ∀ x ∈ f.support ∩ g.support, f x = g x) (hx : f x = g x) (hx' : x ∈ f.support) : f = g

name: IsCycle.pow_iff
statement: Perm β} (hf : IsCycle f) {n : ℕ} : IsCycle (f ^ n) ↔ n.Coprime (orderOf f)

name: IsCycle.isCycle_pow_pos_of_lt_prime_order
statement: Perm β} (hf : IsCycle f) (hf' : (orderOf f).Prime) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hn' : n < orderOf f) : IsCycle (f ^ n)

name: IsCycleOn.pow_apply_eq
statement: Finset α} (hf : f.IsCycleOn s) (ha : a ∈ s) {n : ℕ} : (f ^ n) a = a ↔ #s ∣ n

name: IsCycle.commute_iff'
statement: Perm α} (hc : c.IsCycle) : Commute g c ↔ ∃ hc' : ∀ x : α, g x ∈ c.support ↔ x ∈ c.support, subtypePerm g hc' ∈ Subgroup.zpowers c.subtypePermOfSupport
